boundary_rule: Program identity is not district geometry. Each report needs a versioned study and applicable source geography, scope, vintage, permissions, review status and uncertainty.

pillars.name: Land use and zoning
pillars.required_evidence: Current adopted future land use, zoning, overlays, rights and jurisdiction
pillars.output: Permitted-use and conditional capacity matrix; actual units separate

pillars.name: Transportation and mobility
pillars.required_evidence: Agency jurisdiction, mode-specific networks, project phase, access and safety
pillars.output: Existing vs scenario accessibility and access constraints
pillars.method_reference: LaGro ch. 7–8; O’Sullivan transportation; Urban Analytics networks

pillars.name: Urban design and morphology
pillars.required_evidence: Street/block/parcel geometry, frontages, heights, condition and public realm
pillars.output: Comparative design determinants, alternatives and quantities

pillars.name: Housing and neighborhoods
pillars.required_evidence: Stock, lawful units, tenure, vacancy, rents, costs, household needs
pillars.output: Housing capacity and demand alternatives; no inferred legality

pillars.name: Infrastructure and utilities
pillars.required_evidence: Service owners, network extent, actual capacity, constraints and dated commitments

pillars.name: Economic development
pillars.required_evidence: Establishments, employment, industry mix, business continuity and needs
pillars.output: Economic mechanisms, alternatives and outcome measures
pillars.method_reference: O’Sullivan urban growth; Hack local economy

pillars.name: Commercial districts and Main Streets
pillars.required_evidence: Accepted district boundary, premise inventory, businesses, vacancy and market context
pillars.method_reference: Main Street Approach; Measuring Impact; LaGro

pillars.name: Real estate and capital markets
pillars.required_evidence: Transactions, market rents, costs, rights, funding and comparable evidence
pillars.output: Conditional acquisition economics and capital paths

pillars.name: Municipal finance
pillars.required_evidence: Adopted budgets, tax bases, CIP, incremental revenues and service costs
pillars.output: Public fiscal impact separate from private returns
pillars.method_reference: O’Sullivan local government; Steiner & Butler fiscal impact

pillars.name: Population and migration
pillars.required_evidence: Same-vintage population, households, migration stocks/flows and boundaries
pillars.output: Growth components, assumptions and calibrated forecasts where supported

pillars.name: Education and workforce
pillars.required_evidence: School/training locations, capacity, labor and aggregate skill demand
pillars.output: Workforce fit and educational service-access gaps

pillars.name: Health and public services
pillars.required_evidence: Facility authority, service areas, access, capacity, response and public budgets
pillars.output: Public facility capacity/gaps; no personal health or individual safety ranking
pillars.method_reference: Steiner & Butler facilities; Hack urban systems

pillars.name: Culture and community
pillars.required_evidence: Historic assets, community input, cultural institutions and public spaces

pillars.name: Environment and natural resources
pillars.required_evidence: Soil, topography, water, wetlands, habitats and verified environmental records
pillars.output: Resource constraints and mitigation research, program-dependent
pillars.method_reference: LaGro ch. 5–6,8; Steiner & Butler environmental planning

pillars.name: Parks and green infrastructure
pillars.required_evidence: Canopy, parks, open space, trails, ecology and access
pillars.method_reference: LaGro ch. 6,10; Steiner & Butler open space

pillars.name: Resilience and hazards
pillars.required_evidence: Dated hazard layers, exposure, vulnerability, recovery and service continuity
pillars.output: Hazard-specific conditions and residual risk; no insurance quote

pillars.name: Government, institutions and policy
pillars.required_evidence: Authority, adopted documents, effective dates, jurisdiction and engagement
pillars.output: Policy/authority register; proposals separate from binding rules
pillars.method_reference: Hack; Kelly contents only; Florida handbook historical

pillars.name: Implementation and performance
pillars.required_evidence: Plan revision, responsible authority, funding by phase, observed outcomes
